_description: Non-confidential parameters for arBATT. Every value here can also be overridden by an environment variable bearing the SAME name (e.g. ARBATT_PORT). See README.md for the full reference.
_ARBATT_APP_CONFIG_KEYS: Client config published as www/app-config.json: {clientKey: PARAM_NAME}. The ONLY place listing what the PWA receives; 'version' is always included. Built by arbatt_config.build_app_config().
